title: Imperial Secret Agent
next_chapter_hook: The Crown Prince Grand Tutor's carriage is waiting in the shadows. Will Chen Ji board this seemingly destiny-bound ferry toward power?

text.content: Night hung like ink. Chen Ji stood behind the ruins of a dilapidated temple, Ling Yuan's words still echoing in his ears—"Chen Ji? No, he's been dead for a long time." He slowly closed his eyes, his fingers unconsciously stroking the Tianji Record Fragment against his chest. Dead? Interesting. If Ling Yuan wanted him dead, then he would die for all the world to see. A cold, wicked pleasure surged in his chest—if he had already been sentenced to death, then all future pursuits targeting the "dead man" would become an absurd farce.

A slender black shadow drifted down from the eaves, demonic path mist spreading silently. Ye Qing landed without a sound, her fiery red eyes gleaming faintly in the darkness: "Chen Ji, Ling Yuan just left, but there's another group lurking nearby. Their cultivation is not high, but extremely covert—like... imperial agents." She paused, her voice carrying a rare gravity, "They seem to be looking for you, and they know you're still alive."

Chen Ji raised an eyebrow. The Imperial Court getting involved in Tianqing Sect affairs? That was interesting. Though the Tianqing Sect claimed to be one of the three great sects of the cultivation world, the imperial court and martial sects had always kept to their own domains—unless... core interests of the empire were at stake. His mind raced, yet his expression remained one of utter indifference, even wearing a lazy smile at the corners of his mouth.

dialogue.content: Be careful. The Crown Prince Grand Tutor personally issued this order—tracking a 'deceased' servant disciple. Don't you find that itself highly suspicious?

text.content: Ye Qing's words made Chen Ji's gaze sharpen. The Crown Prince Grand Tutor—that was the most mysterious existence at the heart of imperial power, and it was said even the current Emperor gave him considerable deference. This man's disciples were scattered throughout the court and bureaucracy, and his informants had infiltrated every corner of the cultivation world. What merit did he, a mere servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect, possess to catch the Grand Tutor's eye?

A black figure silently appeared atop the ruined wall, moonlight carving out a thoroughly ordinary face—the kind of plainness that blended into any crowd, a hallmark of top-tier secret agents. The man studied Chen Ji with a measuring gaze, but held no killing intent.

dialogue.content: (Clasping hands, tone neither warm nor cold) Late night visit, quite the gusto. Tell me—are you here to take Chen's head, or to invite Chen for tea?

text.content: The secret agent remained unmoved, only drawing from his sleeve a bronze token engraved with an open eye—the sigil of the Crown Prince Grand Tutor's residence. "Young Master Chen, the Grand Tutor has a message for you." His voice was low and steady, "He said: both of us are pieces on the chessboard. Rather than being pushed about by others, why not place your own stones?"

dialogue.content: (Demonic path mist stirred subtly, gathering power covertly) Place my own stones? Does the Grand Tutor wish to recruit a dead man?

text.content: The secret agent glanced at Ye Qing, seemingly unsurprised by her demonic path identity, even showing a hint of understanding. "Holy Sect Saintess, please relax. If I intended to strike, I wouldn't have revealed myself just now." His gaze returned to Chen Ji. "The Grand Tutor says the imperial succession crisis has reached a tipping point. The three princes each harbor their own schemes, ministers have clearly chosen sides, and in three months, the reckoning will come."

He paused, his tone hardening: "And the Tianqing Sect happens to sit right on the eye of the board. Ling Yuan, the crafty old fox, has already been in secret correspondence with a certain prince; Han Lie's Xuanwu Sect has amassed a hundred thousand troops at the border—ostensibly defending the nation, but in truth awaiting their moment. Young Master Chen, in your view, how much longer can the Tianqing Sect's boat remain steady?"

dialogue.content: (Hands clasped behind back, expression playful) The Grand Tutor does credit Chen with much perception. It's just that there's something I don't understand—how is he so certain I'm still alive?

text.content: The secret agent's lips curved slightly, a meaningful smile forming. "The Grand Tutor says Young Master Chen is a wise man. Wise men don't die easily, especially when the game has only just begun." He drew from his breast a letter sealed with crimson wax. "This is the Grand Tutor's sincerity—core intelligence of the imperial court, concerning political trends, sect maneuvering, and... Young Master Chen's sister, missing for many years."

The name Chen Nian struck his heart like a blade. His eyes instantly turned dangerous, his aura shifting dramatically—the secret agent couldn't help but step back half a pace. Ye Qing sensed the murderous intent roiling within him and inwardly gasped—this was the first time she'd ever seen Chen Ji so shaken.

dialogue.content: (Voice pressed extremely low, each word deliberate) Do you know where my sister is?

text.content: The secret agent shook his head, his expression难得凝重起来。"I don't know. But the Grand Tutor does." He extended the letter. "The Grand Tutor says that Young Master Chen's sister was taken by the Holy Sect to be a 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key'—he's long been aware of this. If Young Master Chen is willing to cooperate, the court's power can help you find her within the Holy Sect."

choice.prompt: The secret agent's proposal left Chen Ji deep in thought. The Crown Prince Grand Tutor seemed full of sincerity, but there was never a free lunch in this world. Was this intelligence honey or poison? Chen Nian's whereabouts mattered greatly, but he had to weigh the pros and cons.

choices.description: Accept the intelligence first to稳住 the secret agent, while covertly investigating the Crown Prince Grand Tutor's true motives. Keeping one avenue open is better than making enemies on all sides.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of being drawn into the imperial political vortex
choices.visible_reward: Gain core imperial intelligence, possibly find clues to Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince Grand Tutor is extremely deep—there's no guarantee he isn't another Ling Yuan

text.content: Chen Ji reached out and accepted the envelope, his movements unhurried. A fleeting smugness flickered in the secret agent's eyes—in his view, nothing was a better leverage over a person than family. Yet what he couldn't see was the glacial coldness in Chen Ji's eyes beneath his lowered lids. Taking the letter didn't mean following the other party's script.

dialogue.content: Please convey my gratitude to the Grand Tutor for his kindness. This favor, Chen will remember.

choices.description: The Crown Prince Grand Tutor's reach extends too far—he must understand that Chen Ji is no pawn to be manipulated. Even with Chen Nian's clues right before his eyes, he cannot lose his composure.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent stance, free from another's control
choices.risk_hint: Risk offending the Crown Prince Grand Tutor, losing an imperial backing

text.content: Chen Ji did not take the letter, merely gazing calmly at the secret agent. "Please convey to the Grand Tutor that Chen is merely a dead man—how could he possibly merit the Grand Tutor's favor?" His tone was placid yet carried unmistakable refusal. "My sister's affairs, I will handle myself."

dialogue.content: (Low voice) Having spine. But... are you certain you don't need that intelligence?

choices.text: Counter-probe to gauge his true cards
choices.description: No rush to decide—first extract more information. Why is the Crown Prince Grand Tutor so fixated on a 'dead man'? There must be more to this.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal what one truly cares about
choices.risk_hint: The secret agent might seize the opportunity to turn the tables

text.content: Chen Ji did not reach out, only fixing the secret agent with a knowing half-smile. "You've said so much, yet you still haven't told me—" he leisurely posed the question, "how is the Crown Prince Grand Tutor so certain I'm still alive? Among thousands of Tianqing Sect servant disciples, why me?"

dialogue.content: Or perhaps... what the Grand Tutor wants was never this person, but something I possess?

text.content: A crack finally appeared in the secret agent's composure. Clearly, he hadn't expected Chen Ji to be so perceptive—to see through the true purpose behind this "recruitment" at a glance. He was silent for a moment, seemingly weighing how much to reveal.

dialogue.content: (Hands clasped behind back, expression playful) The Crown Prince Grand Tutor's pursuit of me—surely it's not merely to recruit a dead man. What he truly wants... is this, isn't it?

text.content: As Chen Ji spoke, he revealed a corner of the Tianji Record Fragment from his breast. The secret agent's pupils contracted sharply—that momentary loss of control said everything. The Grand Tutor indeed knew of the Tianji Record's existence, and probably knew far more than Chen Ji had imagined.

The secret agent drew a deep breath, his disguise falling away entirely, replaced by an equalizing scrutiny. "Young Master Chen lives up to his reputation indeed." His tone shifted—no longer the high-handed recruiter, but an equal partner. "The Grand Tutor says that if you're willing to cooperate, the court can provide the locations of other Tianji Record Fragments."

These words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. The Tianji Record Fragments—that was his foundation, the key to his grand design for world dominance in these turbulent times. If the Crown Prince Grand Tutor truly knew the locations of the other fragments...

dialogue.content: (Transmitting voice) Be careful—the secrets of the Tianji Record cannot be revealed lightly. The Crown Prince Grand Tutor's understanding of the Tianji Record is likely far deeper than we imagined.

text.content: Chen Ji did not respond to Ye Qing's warning, but stared directly at the secret agent. "How did the Grand Tutor learn of the other fragments' locations?" His voice was calm, yet harbored a blade's edge. "As far as I know, the Tianji Record's holders never show their true faces. What makes the Grand Tutor so certain his intelligence is genuine?"
The secret agent fell silent for an instant, as if making some difficult decision. Finally, he spoke slowly: "Because the Grand Tutor himself is the previous Tianji Record holder."

These words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. The previous holder—this meant the Crown Prince Grand Tutor had once been a prophet as well, had once schemed across the world while appearing as 'waste' material. So why had he now chosen to dwell in the imperial court? Why offer the Tianji Record fragments拱手相让?

dialogue.content: (Eyes glinting) What was his reason for abandoning the Tianji Record?

text.content: The secret agent shook his head. "That, I am not authorized to disclose. But the Grand Tutor asked me to convey one thing to you—" his voice dropped low and solemn, "'The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger fate's deadly backlash becomes. The path you walk now, I have already walked. Back then I chose to abandon it. Will you make a different choice?'"

The night had deepened further. The atmosphere in the ruined temple had solidified into something nearly unbearable. Chen Ji stood with lowered eyes, his heart churning with monstrous waves. The Crown Prince Grand Tutor—a man who had once stood where he now stood, ultimately choosing to abandon the Tianji Record and enter the mortal world as an official. Was this cowardice, or another form of supreme wisdom?

Ye Qing watched Chen Ji quietly, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes. She had never seen this man so shaken—the ever-calculating, ever-composed Chen Ji now resembled a child who had lost his direction.

dialogue.content: (Transmitting voice) Chen Ji, whatever you choose, I'm on your side.

text.content: The secret agent extended the sealed envelope once more—this time without urgency, simply waiting in silence. "The Grand Tutor said he's not in a rush. He's giving you three days to consider. In three days, someone will come to escort you." He turned to leave, then paused. "Ah, I nearly forgot to introduce myself—I am An Qi, and I'll be your liaison going forward."

dialogue.content: (Watching the secret agent vanish) An Qi... the Shadow Legion of the court. This man will not be easy to deal with.

text.content: The secret agent's figure merged into the night, leaving only a crimson-sealed letter gleaming with a dull luster under the moonlight. Chen Ji stared at that letter, yet his mind echoed with the Crown Prince Grand Tutor's words—"The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger fate's deadly backlash becomes." He understood what this meant better than anyone.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing, help me investigate something. The Crown Prince Grand Tutor's past—the more details, the better.
(Nodding) Understood. But... are you truly planning to cooperate with the court?
(Gazing down at the envelope in hand, a meaningful smile curling his lips) Cooperate? That's what they think. I was merely considering whether to make this game a little bigger.

text.content: Under the moonlight, Chen Ji broke the seal and opened the envelope, revealing a thin sheet of paper within, inscribed with just a few lines of text. But those few lines made his pupils contract sharply—the paper contained nothing less than the defensive layout of the Holy Sect's main compound, and... the exact location where Chen Nian was imprisoned. "The Crown Prince Grand Tutor awaits your answer."
